```{r utils bj}
# Test portmanteau (Ljung-Box) sur k retards, avec correction de degrés de liberté
Qtests <- function(series, k, fitdf = 0) {
  pvals <- apply(matrix(1:k), 1, FUN = function(l) {
    pval <- if (l <= fitdf) NA
            else Box.test(series, lag = l, type = "Ljung-Box", fitdf = fitdf)$p.value
    return(c("lag" = l, "pval" = pval))
  })
  return(t(pvals))
}

# ADF avec choix automatique du nombre de retards : on incrémente p tant que les
# résidus du test ADF présentent une autocorrélation détectable (Ljung-Box).
# Cf. Lecture 4 p. 22-25 : l'ADF suppose un bruit blanc, il faut donc enrichir
# la spécification jusqu'à ce que cette hypothèse soit vérifiée.
adfTest_valid <- function(series, kmax, adftype) {
  k <- 0
  noautocorr <- 0
  while (noautocorr == 0 && k <= kmax) {
    cat(paste0("ADF avec ", k, " retards : résidus non corrélés ? "))
    adf <- suppressWarnings(adfTest(series, lags = k, type = adftype))
    pvals <- Qtests(adf@test$lm$residuals, 24,
                    fitdf = length(adf@test$lm$coefficients))[, 2]
    if (sum(pvals < 0.05, na.rm = TRUE) == 0) {
      noautocorr <- 1; cat("OUI\n")
    } else cat("non\n")
    k <- k + 1
  }
  return(adf)
}

# test de significativité des coefficients (loi normale asymptotique)
signif <- function(estim) {
  coef <- estim$coef
  se   <- sqrt(diag(estim$var.coef))
  t    <- coef / se
  pval <- (1 - pnorm(abs(t))) * 2
  return(rbind(coef, se, pval))
}

# diag complet d'un ARMA : ajustement + validité
arimafit <- function(estim) {
  adjust <- round(signif(estim), 3)
  pvals  <- Qtests(estim$residuals, 24, fitdf = length(estim$coef))
  pvals  <- matrix(apply(matrix(1:24, nrow = 6), 2,
                         function(c) round(pvals[c, ], 3)), nrow = 6)
  colnames(pvals) <- rep(c("lag", "pval"), 4)
  cat("Tests de nullité des coefficients :\n"); print(adjust)
  cat("\nTests d'absence d'autocorrélation des résidus :\n"); print(pvals)
}
```

```{r estimation validation}
# Pour les ARIMA(p,1,q) avec constante (drift), on travaille directement sur x
# en passant order = c(p, 1, q) et include.mean = TRUE n'est pas autorisé pour d>0
# dans stats::arima ; on utilise donc forecast::Arima avec include.drift = TRUE
# pour incorporer le drift mis en évidence par le t-test sur dx.
#
# Un modèle "bien ajusté" exige la significativité du coefficient AR le plus
# élevé (si p > 0) ET du coefficient MA le plus élevé (si q > 0).

modelchoice <- function(p, q, data = x) {
  estim <- try(forecast::Arima(data, order = c(p, 1, q),
                               include.drift = TRUE,
                               method = "ML"), silent = TRUE)
  if (inherits(estim, "try-error")) {
    return(c(p = p, q = q, arsignif = NA, masignif = NA,
             resnocorr = NA, ok = NA))
  }
  s <- signif(estim)
  # Indices : les coefficients AR sont nommés ar1..arp, MA ma1..maq, drift
  ar_idx <- if (p > 0) which(grepl("^ar", colnames(s)))[p] else NA
  ma_idx <- if (q > 0) which(grepl("^ma", colnames(s)))[q] else NA
  arsignif <- if (p == 0) NA else s["pval", ar_idx] <= 0.05
  masignif <- if (q == 0) NA else s["pval", ma_idx] <= 0.05
  pvals_res <- Qtests(estim$residuals, 24,
                      fitdf = length(estim$coef))[, 2]
  resnocorr <- sum(pvals_res < 0.05, na.rm = TRUE) == 0
  checks <- c(arsignif, masignif, resnocorr)
  ok <- as.numeric(sum(checks, na.rm = TRUE) == (3 - sum(is.na(checks))))
  return(c(p = p, q = q, arsignif = arsignif, masignif = masignif,
           resnocorr = resnocorr, ok = ok))
}

armamodelchoice <- function(pmax, qmax) {
  pqs <- expand.grid(0:pmax, 0:qmax)
  t(apply(matrix(1:dim(pqs)[1]), 1, function(row) {
    p <- pqs[row, 1]; q <- pqs[row, 2]
    cat(paste0("ARIMA(", p, ",1,", q, ") avec drift\n"))
    modelchoice(p, q)
  }))
}

armamodels <- armamodelchoice(pmax, qmax)
print(armamodels)
```

```{r selection valides}

]
selec
```

```{r racines}
# Vérification de la stationnarité de la composante AR : toutes les racines du
# polynôme autorégressif doivent être hors du disque unité. C'est la condition
# de causalité (Lecture 1 p. 29-31).
verifier_racines <- function(p, q, data = x) {
  m <- forecast::Arima(data, order = c(p, 1, q),
                       include.drift = TRUE, method = "ML")
  if (p == 0) return(TRUE)
  ar_coef <- m$coef[grepl("^ar", names(m$coef))]
  racines <- polyroot(c(1, -ar_coef))
  modules <- Mod(racines)
  cat(sprintf("ARIMA(%d,1,%d) avec drift : modules des racines AR = %s\n",
              p, q, paste(round(modules, 3), collapse = ", ")))
  all(modules > 1)
}

if (nrow(selec) > 0) {
  for (i in seq_len(nrow(selec))) {
    verifier_racines(selec[i, "p"], selec[i, "q"])
  }
}
```

```{r aic bic valides}
if (nrow(selec) > 0) {
  pqs <- apply(selec, 1, function(row) {
    list(p = as.numeric(row["p"]), q = as.numeric(row["q"]))
  })
  names(pqs) <- paste0("ARIMA(", selec[, "p"], ",1,", selec[, "q"], ")_d")

  models <- lapply(pqs, function(pq) {
    forecast::Arima(x, order = c(pq$p, 1, pq$q),
                    include.drift = TRUE, method = "ML")
  })

  ic_table <- vapply(models, FUN.VALUE = numeric(2),
                     function(m) c(AIC = AIC(m), BIC = BIC(m)))
  print(ic_table)
}
```

```{r holdout-rmse}
h <- 8
n <- length(x)
x_train <- ts(x[1:(n - h)], start = start(x), frequency = 4)
x_test  <- x[(n - h + 1):n]

if (nrow(selec) > 0) {
  rmse_holdout <- vapply(pqs, FUN.VALUE = numeric(1), function(pq) {
    m_train <- forecast::Arima(x_train, order = c(pq$p, 1, pq$q),
                               include.drift = TRUE, method = "ML")
    fc <- forecast(m_train, h = h)$mean
    sqrt(mean((as.numeric(fc) - as.numeric(x_test))^2)) / sd(x)
  })
  print(round(rmse_holdout, 4))
  cat("\nMeilleure prévision hors-échantillon :",
      names(which.min(rmse_holdout)), "\n")
}
```

```{r choix final}
# Choix final : le modèle qui passe les 4 filtres
# (bien ajusté, valide, racines stables, meilleur sur RMSE OU IC selon le cas)
final_name <- if (nrow(selec) > 0) names(which.min(rmse_holdout)) else NA
cat("Modèle final retenu :", final_name, "\n")
final_model <- if (nrow(selec) > 0) models[[final_name]] else NULL
if (!is.null(final_model)) {
  summary(final_model)
  coeftest(final_model)
}
```

```{r diagnostic final}
if (!is.null(final_model)) {
  
  res <- residuals(final_model)
  
  # 1. Série temp
  # On ajoute ta couleur bleue claire et la ligne zéro en bleu foncé
  p1 <- autoplot(res) +
    geom_line(color = "#1E90FF", linewidth = 0.8) +
    geom_hline(yintercept = 0, color = "#003399", linetype = "dashed", alpha = 0.7) +
    labs(title = "Résidus du modèle final", 
         x = "Trimestre", 
         y = "Erreurs (Résidus)") +
    theme_minimal() +
    theme(plot.title = element_text(face = "bold"))
  
  # ACF
  # Elle calculera les bons retards exactement comme checkresiduals
  p2 <- ggAcf(res) +
    labs(title = "Autocorrélation des résidus (ACF)",
         y = "ACF") +
    theme_minimal()
  
  p2$layers[[1]]$aes_params$colour <- "#1E90FF" 
  p2$layers[[2]]$aes_params$colour <- "#003399"
  
  # Histogramme + courbe Normale
  p3 <- gghistogram(res, add.normal = TRUE, add.kde = FALSE) +
    labs(title = "Distribution des résidus", 
         x = "Valeur des résidus", 
         y = "Densité") +
    theme_minimal()
  
  p3$layers[[1]]$aes_params$fill <- "#1E90FF"   
  p3$layers[[1]]$aes_params$colour <- "white"   
  p3$layers[[2]]$aes_params$colour <- "#003399" 
  p3$layers[[2]]$aes_params$linewidth <- 1.2
  
  # assemblage + sauvegarde
  pdf("plot_diagnostic_residus_final.pdf", width = 12, height = 8)
  grid.arrange(p1, p2, p3, layout_matrix = rbind(c(1,1), c(2,3)))
  dev.off()
  
  # affichage direct 
  grid.arrange(p1, p2, p3, layout_matrix = rbind(c(1,1), c(2,3)))
  
  # tests statistiques
  checkresiduals(final_model, plot = FALSE)
  jarque.bera.test(na.omit(res)) # na.omit sécurise le test
}
```

```{r prevision finale}
if (!is.null(final_model)) {
  prev <- forecast(final_model, h = 12)

  # historique
  hist_df <- tibble::tibble(
    QUARTER = zoo::as.yearqtr(time(prev$x)),
    value   = as.numeric(prev$x)
  )

  # prévisions brutes
  fc_raw <- tibble::tibble(
    QUARTER  = zoo::as.yearqtr(time(prev$mean)),
    forecast = as.numeric(prev$mean),
    lower_80 = as.numeric(prev$lower[, 1]),
    upper_80 = as.numeric(prev$upper[, 1]),
    lower_95 = as.numeric(prev$lower[, 2]),
    upper_95 = as.numeric(prev$upper[, 2])
  )

  # On rattache le dernier point historique au début de la prévision pour
  # éviter la discontinuité visuelle entre la courbe d'historique et la
  # courbe de prévision (les deux geom_line sont sinon disjoints).
  last_hist <- hist_df %>%
    dplyr::slice_tail(n = 1) %>%
    dplyr::transmute(
      QUARTER  = QUARTER,
      forecast = value,
      lower_80 = value, upper_80 = value,
      lower_95 = value, upper_95 = value
    )

  fc_df <- dplyr::bind_rows(last_hist, fc_raw)

  ggplot() +
    geom_ribbon(data = fc_df,
                aes(x = QUARTER, ymin = lower_95, ymax = upper_95),
                fill = "#B3D1FF", alpha = 0.45) +
    geom_ribbon(data = fc_df,
                aes(x = QUARTER, ymin = lower_80, ymax = upper_80),
                fill = "#8C9DB5", alpha = 0.35) +
    geom_line(data = hist_df,
              aes(x = QUARTER, y = value),
              color = "#003399", linewidth = 1.2) +
    geom_line(data = fc_df,
              aes(x = QUARTER, y = forecast),
              color = "#1E90FF", linewidth = 1.1) +
    geom_vline(xintercept = max(hist_df$QUARTER),
               linetype = "dashed", color = "#8C9DB5") +
    zoo::scale_x_yearqtr(format = "%Y%q") +
    scale_y_continuous(labels = scales::label_number(accuracy = 1)) +
    labs(x = "Trimestre", y = "Montant (en millions de dollars)") +
    theme_minimal(base_size = 12)+
    theme(
      # --- AGRANDISSEMENT DES TEXTES ---
      axis.title.x = element_text(size = 14, face = "bold"),
      axis.title.y = element_text(size = 14, face = "bold"),
      axis.text.x  = element_text(size = 12),
      axis.text.y  = element_text(size = 12)
    )
  ggsave("plot_prevision_finale.pdf", width = 12, height = 8, dpi = 300)
}
```

```{r import ciss}
data_ciss <- read.csv(file.path(data_dir, "CISS.csv"))

  order.by = data_ciss$Date

ciss_quarterly_xts <- apply.quarterly(ciss_xts, FUN = mean)

# Conversion robuste vers ts : on extrait l'année et le trimestre du PREMIER
# point via as.yearqtr (apply.quarterly horodate à la fin du trimestre, donc
# il faut passer par yearqtr pour ne pas se tromper de trimestre)
ciss_first <- zoo::as.yearqtr(index(ciss_quarterly_xts)[1])

                as.integer(format(ciss_first, "%q")))

ciss_ts <- ts(as.numeric(ciss_quarterly_xts),
              start = ciss_start, frequency = 4)

# Stationnarité du CISS
trend_ciss <- 1:length(ciss_ts)
lm_ciss <- lm(as.numeric(ciss_ts) ~ trend_ciss)
adftype_ciss <- if (summary(lm_ciss)$coefficients[2, 4] < 0.05) "ct" else "c"
adf_ciss <- adfTest_valid(ciss_ts, kmax = 12, adftype = adftype_ciss)
```

```{r alignement eu}
# Plages effectives de chaque série
range_dx_eu  <- c(start(dx_eu),  end(dx_eu))
range_dciss  <- c(start(dciss),  end(dciss))
cat("Plage de dx_eu  :", paste(range_dx_eu[1:2], collapse = "-"),
    "à", paste(range_dx_eu[3:4], collapse = "-"), "\n")
cat("Plage de dciss  :", paste(range_dciss[1:2], collapse = "-"),
    "à", paste(range_dciss[3:4], collapse = "-"), "\n")

# Conversion en yearqtr pour comparer proprement les bornes
yq <- function(yr_q) zoo::as.yearqtr(yr_q[1] + (yr_q[2] - 1) / 4)

start_common <- max(yq(start(dx_eu)),  yq(start(dciss)))
end_common   <- min(yq(end(dx_eu)),    yq(end(dciss)))

# Reconversion en couple (année, trimestre)
to_tsstart <- function(yqv) {
  yr <- as.integer(format(yqv, "%Y"))
  qt <- as.integer(format(yqv, "%q"))
  c(yr, qt)
}
common_start <- to_tsstart(start_common)
common_end   <- to_tsstart(end_common)
cat("Fenêtre commune retenue :",
    paste(common_start, collapse = "-"), "à",
    paste(common_end,   collapse = "-"), "\n")

dx_aligne_eu <- window(dx_eu,  start = common_start, end = common_end)
dciss_aligne <- window(dciss, start = common_start, end = common_end)

# Maintenant les longueurs ET les dates doivent matcher exactement
stopifnot(length(dx_aligne_eu) == length(dciss_aligne))
stopifnot(all.equal(as.numeric(time(dx_aligne_eu)),
                    as.numeric(time(dciss_aligne))))
cat("Longueur du système bivarié :", length(dx_aligne_eu), "trimestres\n")
```

```{r var select}
systeme_bivarie <- cbind(dx_aligne_eu, dciss_aligne)
colnames(systeme_bivarie) <- c("Exposition", "DCISS")

VARselect(systeme_bivarie, lag.max = 8, type = "const")
```

```{r var diagnostic}
# Stabilité du VAR : toutes les racines doivent être à l'intérieur du cercle unité

# Normalité des résidus (utile pour les IC des prévisions et IRF)
normality.test(modele_var)
```

```{r ts estimation validation}
# filtre validité identique à celui de la Partie 1
ts_modelchoice <- function(p, q, series = y_hat) {
  estim <- try(forecast::Arima(series, order = c(p, 0, q),
                               include.mean = TRUE,
                               method = "ML"), silent = TRUE)
  if (inherits(estim, "try-error")) {
    return(c(p = p, q = q, arsignif = NA, masignif = NA,
             resnocorr = NA, ok = NA, aic = NA, bic = NA))
  }
  s <- signif(estim)
  ar_idx <- if (p > 0) which(grepl("^ar", colnames(s)))[p] else NA
  ma_idx <- if (q > 0) which(grepl("^ma", colnames(s)))[q] else NA
  arsignif <- if (p == 0) NA else s["pval", ar_idx] <= 0.05
  masignif <- if (q == 0) NA else s["pval", ma_idx] <= 0.05
  pvals_res <- Qtests(estim$residuals, 24,
                      fitdf = length(estim$coef))[, 2]
  resnocorr <- sum(pvals_res < 0.05, na.rm = TRUE) == 0
  checks <- c(arsignif, masignif, resnocorr)
  ok <- as.numeric(sum(checks, na.rm = TRUE) == (3 - sum(is.na(checks))))
  return(c(p = p, q = q, arsignif = arsignif, masignif = masignif,
           resnocorr = resnocorr, ok = ok, aic = AIC(estim), bic = BIC(estim)))
}

pqs_ts <- expand.grid(0:2, 0:1)
ts_results <- t(apply(pqs_ts, 1, function(row) {
  p <- row[1]; q <- row[2]
  cat(sprintf("ARMA(%d,%d) sur résidus OLS\n", p, q))
  ts_modelchoice(p, q)
}))

cat("\nTableau de validité (Modèle A — trend-stationary) :\n")
print(ts_results)

ts_valides <- ts_results[!is.na(ts_results[, "ok"]) &
                          ts_results[, "ok"] == 1, , drop = FALSE]
if (nrow(ts_valides) > 0) {
  cat("\nModèles bien ajustés ET valides :\n")
  print(ts_valides[order(ts_valides[, "bic"]),
                   c("p", "q", "aic", "bic")])
  best_ts <- ts_valides[which.min(ts_valides[, "bic"]), ]
  cat(sprintf("\nMeilleur modèle A : ARMA(%d,%d) sur résidus OLS (BIC = %.1f)\n",
              best_ts["p"], best_ts["q"], best_ts["bic"]))
} else {
  cat("\nAucun modèle ARMA valide sur les résidus OLS.\n")
}
```

```{r ts diagnostics}
if (nrow(ts_valides) > 0) {
  # Estimation du meilleur modèle A
  modA <- forecast::Arima(y_hat,
                          order = c(best_ts["p"], 0, best_ts["q"]),
                          include.mean = TRUE, method = "ML")
  cat("Coefficients du Modèle A :\n")
  print(summary(modA))
  pdf("plot_diagnostic_residus_modA.pdf", width = 12, height = 8)
  checkresiduals(modA)
  dev.off()
  checkresiduals(modA)
  # Racines AR si p > 0
  if (best_ts["p"] > 0) {
    ar_coef <- modA$coef[grepl("^ar", names(modA$coef))]
    racines <- polyroot(c(1, -ar_coef))
    cat("Modules des racines AR :", round(Mod(racines), 3), "\n")
  }
}
```

```{r ts vs ds comparison}
h_comp <- 8
n_comp <- length(x)
x_train_comp <- ts(x[1:(n_comp - h_comp)], start = start(x), frequency = 4)
x_test_comp  <- x[(n_comp - h_comp + 1):n_comp]
trend_full   <- 1:n_comp

rmse_norm_comp <- function(fc, actual) {
  sqrt(mean((as.numeric(fc) - as.numeric(actual))^2)) / sd(x)
}

# --- Modèle B (difference-stationary) ---
modB_train <- forecast::Arima(x_train_comp,
                              order = c(0, 1, 1),
                              include.drift = TRUE, method = "ML")
fc_B <- forecast(modB_train, h = h_comp)$mean

# --- Modèle A (trend-stationary) ---
if (nrow(ts_valides) > 0) {
  # Ré-estimer lm + ARMA sur la portion d'entraînement
  trend_train <- 1:length(x_train_comp)
  lm_train <- lm(as.numeric(x_train_comp) ~ trend_train)
  y_hat_train <- ts(residuals(lm_train),
                    start = start(x_train_comp), frequency = 4)

  modA_train <- forecast::Arima(y_hat_train,
                                order = c(best_ts["p"], 0, best_ts["q"]),
                                include.mean = TRUE, method = "ML")
  fc_A_resid <- forecast(modA_train, h = h_comp)$mean

  # Reconversion en niveaux : X_hat = alpha + beta*(T+h) + Y_hat_ARMA
  alpha_hat <- coef(lm_train)[1]
  beta_hat  <- coef(lm_train)[2]
  trend_fc  <- (length(x_train_comp) + 1):(length(x_train_comp) + h_comp)
  fc_A <- alpha_hat + beta_hat * trend_fc + as.numeric(fc_A_resid)

  # --- Comparaison ---
  comparison <- tibble::tibble(
    Modèle = c(
      sprintf("A — Trend-stat. + ARMA(%d,%d)", best_ts["p"], best_ts["q"]),
      "B — ARIMA(0,1,1) + drift",
      "Naïf — RW + drift"
    ),
    `RMSE / sd(x)` = c(
      rmse_norm_comp(fc_A, x_test_comp),
      rmse_norm_comp(fc_B, x_test_comp),
      rmse_norm_comp(forecast::rwf(x_train_comp, h = h_comp,
                                   drift = TRUE)$mean, x_test_comp)
    )
  )

  knitr::kable(comparison, digits = 4,
               caption = "Comparaison trend-stationary (A) vs difference-stationary (B)") %>%
    kableExtra::kable_styling(full_width = FALSE)

  # --- Graphe des prévisions superposées ---
  df_comp <- tibble::tibble(
    date = as.Date(zoo::as.yearqtr(time(x))),
    historique = as.numeric(x)
  )
  dates_fc <- as.Date(zoo::as.yearqtr(time(fc_B)))

  df_fc <- tibble::tibble(
    date = dates_fc,
    `Modèle A (trend-stat.)` = fc_A,
    `Modèle B (ARIMA 0,1,1)` = as.numeric(fc_B),
    Observé = as.numeric(x_test_comp)
  ) %>%
    tidyr::pivot_longer(-date, names_to = "Série", values_to = "valeur")

  ggplot() +
    geom_line(data = df_comp, aes(x = date, y = historique),
              color = "#003399", linewidth = 1.2) +
    geom_line(data = df_fc, aes(x = date, y = valeur, color = Série),
              linewidth = 1) +
    geom_vline(xintercept = max(df_comp$date) - h_comp * 91,
               linetype = "dashed", color = "#8C9DB5") +
    scale_color_manual(values = c(
      "Modèle A (trend-stat.)" = "#E63946",
      "Modèle B (ARIMA 0,1,1)" = "#1E90FF",
      "Observé" = "#28B463"
    )) +
    labs(title = "Prévisions : trend-stationary (A) vs difference-stationary (B)",
         x = "Trimestre", y = "Montant (M USD)",
         color = "") +
    theme_minimal() +
    theme(legend.position = "bottom")
  ggsave("plot_comparaison_trend_diff.pdf", width = 12, height = 8, dpi = 300)
} else {
  cat("Pas de modèle A valide — la comparaison se réduit au Modèle B.\n")
}
```

```{r benchmarks}
if (!is.null(final_model)) {
  h <- 8
  n <- length(x)
  x_train <- ts(x[1:(n - h)], start = start(x), frequency = 4)
  x_test  <- x[(n - h + 1):n]

  # Modèle ARIMA réestimé sur la portion d'entraînement
  arima_train <- forecast::Arima(x_train,
                                 order = c(0, 1, 1),
                                 include.drift = TRUE, method = "ML")

  # Benchmarks naïfs
  rwf_train   <- forecast::rwf(x_train, h = h, drift = TRUE)
  snaive_train <- forecast::snaive(x_train, h = h)

  # Prévisions
  fc_arima  <- forecast(arima_train, h = h)$mean
  fc_rwf    <- rwf_train$mean
  fc_snaive <- snaive_train$mean

  # RMSE normalisé par sd(x)
  rmse_norm <- function(fc, actual) {
    sqrt(mean((as.numeric(fc) - as.numeric(actual))^2)) / sd(x)
  }

  benchmark_table <- tibble::tibble(
    Modèle = c("ARIMA(0,1,1) + drift", "Random walk + drift", "Naïf saisonnier"),
    `RMSE / sd(x)` = c(rmse_norm(fc_arima, x_test),
                       rmse_norm(fc_rwf, x_test),
                       rmse_norm(fc_snaive, x_test))
  )

  knitr::kable(benchmark_table, digits = 4,
               caption = "Comparaison de la qualité prédictive (8 trimestres hors-échantillon)") %>%
    kableExtra::kable_styling(full_width = FALSE)
}
```

```{r irf ciss}
if (exists("modele_var")) {
  
  # génération des données IRF 
  irf_ciss <- vars::irf(modele_var, impulse = "DCISS", response = "Exposition",
                         n.ahead = 8, boot = TRUE, runs = 500, ci = 0.90)
  
  irf_expo <- vars::irf(modele_var, impulse = "Exposition", response = "DCISS",
                         n.ahead = 8, boot = TRUE, runs = 500, ci = 0.90)

  # fonction interne pour tracer irf
  plot_irf_pro <- function(irf_obj, titre, y_lab) {
  # Extraction des données de réponse
  # On utilise irf_obj$irf[[1]] pour extraire la matrice de réponse
  res_mat <- irf_obj$irf[[1]]
  
  # On calcule l'horizon en comptant le nombre de lignes (-1 car on commence à 0)
  horizon_max <- nrow(res_mat) - 1
  
  # Création du data frame de manière plus robuste
  df <- data.frame(
    Horizon = 0:horizon_max,
    Response = as.numeric(res_mat),
    Lower = as.numeric(irf_obj$Lower[[1]]),
    Upper = as.numeric(irf_obj$Upper[[1]])
  )
  
  ggplot(df, aes(x = Horizon)) +
    # Zone de confiance remplie (#1E90FF avec 20% d'opacité)
    geom_ribbon(aes(ymin = Lower, ymax = Upper), fill = "#1E90FF", alpha = 0.2) +
    # Lignes de l'intervalle en pointillé bleu clair
    geom_line(aes(y = Lower), color = "#1E90FF", linetype = "dashed", linewidth = 0.5) +
    geom_line(aes(y = Upper), color = "#1E90FF", linetype = "dashed", linewidth = 0.5) +
    # Ligne de zéro pour la référence
    geom_hline(yintercept = 0, color = "black", linewidth = 0.5) +
    # Tracé médian en bleu foncé #003399
    geom_line(aes(y = Response), color = "#003399", linewidth = 1.2) +
    # Configuration des axes
    scale_x_continuous(breaks = seq(0, horizon_max, by = 1)) +
    labs(title = titre, x = "Trimestres après le choc", y = y_lab) +
    theme_minimal() +
    theme(
      axis.title.x = element_text(size = 14, face = "bold"),
      axis.title.y = element_text(size = 14, face = "bold"),
      axis.text.x  = element_text(size = 12),
      axis.text.y  = element_text(size = 12),
      plot.title   = element_text(size = 16, face = "bold")
    )
}

  # generation + sauvegarde
  
  # graphique 1 : Choc CISS -> Exposition
  p1 <- plot_irf_pro(irf_ciss, "Réponse de l'exposition à un choc CISS", "Exposition")
  print(p1)
  ggsave("plot_irf_ciss_expo.pdf", plot = p1, width = 12, height = 8)

  # graphique 2 : Choc Exposition -> CISS
  p2 <- plot_irf_pro(irf_expo, "Réponse du CISS à un choc d'exposition", "Delta CISS")
  print(p2)
  ggsave("plot_irf_expo_ciss.pdf", plot = p2, width = 12, height = 8)
}
```

```{r fevd}
  fevd_var <- vars::fevd(modele_var, n.ahead = 8)
  cat("Décomposition de la variance — Δexposition :\n")
  print(round(fevd_var$Exposition, 4))
  cat("\nDécomposition de la variance — ΔCISS :\n")
  print(round(fevd_var$DCISS, 4))
}
```

```{r johansen}
if (exists("x_eu") && exists("ciss_ts")) {
  # Vérifier les bornes communes de manière robuste
  start_common_lev <- max(yq(start(x_eu)), yq(start(ciss_ts)))
  end_common_lev   <- min(yq(end(x_eu)),    yq(end(ciss_ts)))
  cs_lev <- to_tsstart(start_common_lev)
  ce_lev <- to_tsstart(end_common_lev)

  x_eu_lev    <- window(x_eu,    start = cs_lev, end = ce_lev)
  ciss_ts_lev <- window(ciss_ts, start = cs_lev, end = ce_lev)

  # IMPORTANT : remettre les deux séries à des échelles comparables avant ca.jo.
  # x_eu_lev est en millions USD (~10^7), ciss_ts_lev est dans [0, 0.5].
  # Sans rescaling, la matrice de covariance combinée est numériquement
  # singulière (~14 ordres de grandeur d'écart sur les valeurs propres) et
  # urca::ca.jo retourne 'system is computationally singular'. Le test de
  # Johansen est invariant aux transformations linéaires, donc rescaler ne
  # change pas le résultat — c'est purement un problème numérique.
  exposition_scaled <- as.numeric(x_eu_lev) / 1e6   # → en milliers de Md USD
  ciss_scaled       <- as.numeric(ciss_ts_lev)       # déjà dans [0, 0.5]

  niveaux <- cbind(exposition_scaled, ciss_scaled)
  colnames(niveaux) <- c("Exposition", "CISS")

  cat("Échelles après rescaling :\n")
  cat(sprintf("  Exposition : moyenne = %.2f, sd = %.2f\n",
              mean(niveaux[, "Exposition"]), sd(niveaux[, "Exposition"])))
  cat(sprintf("  CISS       : moyenne = %.2f, sd = %.2f\n",
              mean(niveaux[, "CISS"]), sd(niveaux[, "CISS"])))

  # Test de Johansen avec K=2 (correspond au VAR(1) en différences)
  joh <- urca::ca.jo(niveaux, type = "trace", ecdet = "const", K = 2)
  summary(joh)
}
```

```{r rolling granger}
if (exists("systeme_bivarie")) {
  window_size <- 20
  n_total <- nrow(systeme_bivarie)

  if (n_total > window_size) {
    rolling_results <- tibble::tibble(
      end_quarter = numeric(),
      pval_ciss_to_expo = numeric(),
      pval_expo_to_ciss = numeric()
    )

    for (i in window_size:n_total) {
      window_data <- systeme_bivarie[(i - window_size + 1):i, ]
      mod_window <- try(vars::VAR(window_data, p = 1, type = "const"), silent = TRUE)

      if (!inherits(mod_window, "try-error")) {
        gc1 <- try(vars::causality(mod_window, cause = "DCISS")$Granger$p.value,
                   silent = TRUE)
        gc2 <- try(vars::causality(mod_window, cause = "Exposition")$Granger$p.value,
                   silent = TRUE)

        rolling_results <- rolling_results %>%
          dplyr::add_row(
            end_quarter = as.numeric(time(systeme_bivarie))[i],
            pval_ciss_to_expo = if (inherits(gc1, "try-error")) NA_real_ else gc1,
            pval_expo_to_ciss = if (inherits(gc2, "try-error")) NA_real_ else gc2
          )
      }
    }

    # préparation des données pour ggplot
    rolling_long <- rolling_results %>%
      tidyr::pivot_longer(cols = c(pval_ciss_to_expo, pval_expo_to_ciss),
                          names_to = "direction", values_to = "pval") %>%
      dplyr::mutate(direction = dplyr::recode(direction,
        pval_ciss_to_expo = "Variation CISS -> Variation Exposition",
        pval_expo_to_ciss = "Variation Exposition -> Variation CISS"))

    # graphique
    p_rolling <- ggplot(rolling_long, aes(x = end_quarter, y = pval, color = direction)) +
      geom_line(linewidth = 1.2) +
      geom_point(size = 3) +
      geom_hline(yintercept = 0.05, linetype = "dashed", color = "red", linewidth = 0.8) +
      geom_hline(yintercept = 0.10, linetype = "dotted", color = "black", linewidth = 0.8) +
      scale_color_manual(values = c("Variation CISS -> Variation Exposition" = "#003399",
                                     "Variation Exposition -> Variation CISS" = "#1E90FF")) +
      labs(subtitle = "Lignes pointillées : seuils de significativité 5% et 10%",
           x = "Trimestre de fin de fenêtre", 
           y = "p-value (Granger)",
           color = "Direction de causalité :") +
      theme_minimal() +
      theme(
        # aggrandissement textes
        axis.title.x = element_text(size = 14, face = "bold"),
        axis.title.y = element_text(size = 14, face = "bold"),
        axis.text.x  = element_text(size = 12),
        axis.text.y  = element_text(size = 12),
        plot.subtitle = element_text(size = 11, italic = TRUE),
        
        # idem pour légende
        legend.position = "bottom",
        legend.title = element_text(size = 9, face = "bold"),
        legend.text  = element_text(size = 9),
        legend.background = element_rect(fill = "white", color = "#E7EBF2")
      )

    # affichage + sauvegarde
    print(p_rolling)
    ggsave("plot_rolling_granger.pdf", plot = p_rolling, width = 12, height = 8, dpi = 300)
  }
}
```

```{r per-country-arima}
if (exists("expo_priority") && nrow(expo_priority) > 0) {

  pipeline_pays <- function(series_pays, nom_pays) {
    cat("\n========== ", nom_pays, " ==========\n")

    if (length(series_pays) < 20 || sum(!is.na(series_pays)) < 20) {
      cat("Série trop courte pour analyse rigoureuse — passée\n")
      return(NULL)
    }

    trend_t <- 1:length(series_pays)
    lm_pays <- lm(as.numeric(series_pays) ~ trend_t)
    p_trend  <- summary(lm_pays)$coefficients[2, 4]
    spec_adf <- if (p_trend < 0.05) "ct" else "c"
    cat(sprintf("Tendance significative ? p = %.4f → spec ADF '%s'\n",
                p_trend, spec_adf))

    adf_lev <- try(adfTest_valid(series_pays, kmax = 8, adftype = spec_adf),
                   silent = TRUE)
    if (inherits(adf_lev, "try-error")) {
      cat("ADF en échec sur niveau\n"); return(NULL)
    }
    p_adf_lev <- adf_lev@test$p.value
    cat(sprintf("ADF niveau : p = %.4f\n", p_adf_lev))

    d_pays <- if (p_adf_lev > 0.05) 1 else 0
    if (d_pays == 1) {
      ds       <- diff(series_pays)
      adf_diff <- try(adfTest_valid(ds, kmax = 8, adftype = "c"), silent = TRUE)
      if (!inherits(adf_diff, "try-error"))
        cat(sprintf("ADF différencié : p = %.4f\n", adf_diff@test$p.value))
    }

    grille <- expand.grid(p = 0:3, q = 0:1)

    resultats <- lapply(1:nrow(grille), function(i) {
      pp <- grille$p[i]; qq <- grille$q[i]
      mod <- try(forecast::Arima(series_pays,
                                 order        = c(pp, d_pays, qq),
                                 include.drift = (d_pays == 1),
                                 method       = "ML"), silent = TRUE)
      if (inherits(mod, "try-error"))
        return(data.frame(p=pp, q=qq, ar_ok=NA, ma_ok=NA,
                          res_ok=NA, ok=NA, aic=NA, bic=NA))

      s      <- signif(mod)
      ar_idx <- if (pp > 0) which(grepl("^ar", colnames(s)))[pp] else NA
      ma_idx <- if (qq > 0) which(grepl("^ma", colnames(s)))[qq] else NA
      ar_ok  <- if (pp == 0) NA else s["pval", ar_idx] <= 0.05
      ma_ok  <- if (qq == 0) NA else s["pval", ma_idx] <= 0.05

      pvres    <- Qtests(mod$residuals, 24, fitdf = length(mod$coef))[, 2]
      res_ok   <- sum(pvres < 0.05, na.rm = TRUE) == 0
      checks   <- c(ar_ok, ma_ok, res_ok)
      ok       <- as.numeric(sum(checks, na.rm=TRUE) == (3 - sum(is.na(checks))))
      data.frame(p=pp, q=qq, ar_ok=ar_ok, ma_ok=ma_ok,
                 res_ok=res_ok, ok=ok, aic=AIC(mod), bic=BIC(mod))
    })
    res_df <- do.call(rbind, resultats)

    valides <- res_df[!is.na(res_df$ok) & res_df$ok == 1, , drop = FALSE]
    if (nrow(valides) == 0) {
      cat("Aucun modèle bien ajusté ET valide trouvé\n"); return(NULL)
    }
    cat(sprintf("Modèles retenus : %d\n", nrow(valides)))
    print(valides[order(valides$bic), c("p", "q", "aic", "bic")])

    best <- valides[which.min(valides$bic), ]
    cat(sprintf("Modèle final : ARIMA(%d,%d,%d)%s\n",
                best$p, d_pays, best$q,
                if (d_pays == 1) " avec drift" else ""))
    return(list(p=best$p, d=d_pays, q=best$q, aic=best$aic, bic=best$bic))
  }

  results_pays <- list()
  for (pays in c("KY", "GB", "LU", "IE", "JP")) {
    serie_pays <- expo_priority %>%
      dplyr::filter(country == pays) %>%
      dplyr::arrange(QUARTER) %>%
      dplyr::pull(exposure_nbfi)
    if (length(serie_pays) > 0) {
      ts_pays <- ts(serie_pays, start = c(2013, 4), frequency = 4)
      results_pays[[pays]] <- pipeline_pays(ts_pays, pays)
    }
  }

  recap <- do.call(rbind, lapply(names(results_pays), function(p) {
    if (!is.null(results_pays[[p]]))
      data.frame(Pays   = p,
                 Modèle = sprintf("ARIMA(%d,%d,%d)",
                                  results_pays[[p]]$p,
                                  results_pays[[p]]$d,
                                  results_pays[[p]]$q),
                 AIC    = round(results_pays[[p]]$aic, 1),
                 BIC    = round(results_pays[[p]]$bic, 1))
  }))
  if (!is.null(recap))
    knitr::kable(recap, caption = "Modèles ARIMA retenus par pays de contrepartie") %>%
      kableExtra::kable_styling(full_width = FALSE)
}
```

```{r data-panel-fred}
# Construction de la base macro trimestrielle FRED
build_quarterly <- function(filepath, var_name) {
  d <- readr::read_csv(filepath, show_col_types = FALSE)
  date_col <- names(d)[1]    # première col = date
  val_col  <- names(d)[2]
  d <- d %>%
    dplyr::mutate(date = as.Date(.data[[date_col]]),
                  value = as.numeric(.data[[val_col]])) %>%
    dplyr::filter(!is.na(date), !is.na(value))
  d_xts <- xts::xts(d$value, order.by = d$date)
  d_qtr <- xts::apply.quarterly(d_xts, FUN = mean, na.rm = TRUE)

  result <- tibble::tibble(
    date = zoo::index(d_qtr),
    !!var_name := as.numeric(d_qtr)
  ) %>%
    dplyr::mutate(QUARTER = paste0(format(date, "%Y"), "-Q",
                                    lubridate::quarter(date))) %>%
    dplyr::select(QUARTER, !!sym(var_name))
  return(result)
}

# Note: Les chemins utilisent le même répertoire que les autres données du projet
# Les chemins utilisent data_dir défini au début du notebook

    ),

  # Heatmap des corrélations entre variables explicatives
  fred_cor <- fred_quarterly %>%
    dplyr::select(-QUARTER) %>%
    stats::cor(use = "pairwise.complete.obs")
  cat("\nMatrice de corrélation des variables macro :\n")
  print(round(fred_cor, 3))
```

```{r panel construction}
# Construction du panel pays × trimestre
if (exists("expo_priority") && exists("fred_quarterly")) {

  panel_data <- expo_priority %>%
    dplyr::left_join(fred_quarterly, by = "QUARTER") %>%
    dplyr::group_by(country) %>%
    dplyr::arrange(QUARTER) %>%
    dplyr::mutate(
      d_exposure = exposure_nbfi - dplyr::lag(exposure_nbfi),
      d_vix      = vix    - dplyr::lag(vix),
      d_baa      = baa10y - dplyr::lag(baa10y),
      d_dff      = dff    - dplyr::lag(dff),
      d_t10y2y   = t10y2y - dplyr::lag(t10y2y),
      # Lag 1 des variables macro pour spécification dynamique
      d_vix_l1    = dplyr::lag(d_vix, 1),
      d_baa_l1    = dplyr::lag(d_baa, 1),
      d_dff_l1    = dplyr::lag(d_dff, 1),
      d_t10y2y_l1 = dplyr::lag(d_t10y2y, 1)
    ) %>%
    dplyr::ungroup() %>%
    dplyr::filter(!is.na(d_exposure))

  cat("Panel construit :", nrow(panel_data), "obs.\n")
  cat("Pays :", paste(unique(panel_data$country), collapse = ", "), "\n")

  # Conversion en pdata.frame
  panel_pdf <- plm::pdata.frame(panel_data, index = c("country", "QUARTER"))
}
```

```{r panel-specs}
if (exists("panel_pdf")) {

  spec1 <- try(plm::plm(
    d_exposure ~ d_vix + d_baa + d_dff + d_t10y2y,
    data = panel_pdf, model = "within", effect = "individual"
  ), silent = TRUE)

  spec2 <- try(plm::plm(
    d_exposure ~ d_vix + d_baa + d_dff + d_t10y2y,
    data = panel_pdf, model = "within", effect = "twoways"
  ), silent = TRUE)

  spec3 <- try(plm::plm(
    d_exposure ~ d_vix + d_baa + d_dff + d_t10y2y +
                 d_vix_l1 + d_baa_l1 + d_dff_l1 + d_t10y2y_l1,
    data = panel_pdf, model = "within", effect = "individual"
  ), silent = TRUE)

  panel_pdf$d_exposure_l1 <- plm::lag(panel_pdf$d_exposure, 1)
  spec4 <- try(plm::plm(
    d_exposure ~ d_exposure_l1 + d_vix + d_baa + d_dff + d_t10y2y,
    data = panel_pdf, model = "within", effect = "individual"
  ), silent = TRUE)

  print_spec <- function(spec, name) {
    cat(paste0("\n=== ", name, " ===\n"))
    if (inherits(spec, "try-error")) {
      cat("Échec de l'estimation :", attr(spec, "condition")$message, "\n")
      cat("(Probable cause : trop de NA ou degrés de liberté insuffisants)\n")
    } else {
      print(lmtest::coeftest(spec, vcov = plm::vcovHC(spec, cluster = "group")))
    }
  }

  print_spec(spec1, "Spec 1 : FE pays seuls")
  print_spec(spec2, "Spec 2 : FE pays + temps (two-ways)")
  print_spec(spec3, "Spec 3 : FE pays + retards")
  print_spec(spec4, "Spec 4 : modèle dynamique (lagged DV)")

  cat("\n=== Diagnostic du panel ===\n")
  cat("Observations totales :", nrow(panel_pdf), "\n")
  cat("Observations complètes (toutes variables) :",
      sum(complete.cases(panel_pdf[, c("d_exposure", "d_vix", "d_baa",
                                        "d_dff", "d_t10y2y")])), "\n")
  cat("Pays :", length(unique(panel_pdf$country)), "\n")
  cat("Trimestres :", length(unique(panel_pdf$QUARTER)), "\n")

  if (!inherits(spec1, "try-error")) {
    spec_re <- try(plm::plm(
      d_exposure ~ d_vix + d_baa + d_dff + d_t10y2y,
      data = panel_pdf, model = "random"
    ), silent = TRUE)
    if (!inherits(spec_re, "try-error")) {
      cat("\nTest de Hausman (FE vs RE) :\n")
      print(plm::phtest(spec1, spec_re))
    }
  }
}
```

```{r delta delta reg}
if (exists("expo_bn") && exists("fred_quarterly")) {
  bn <- expo_bn %>%
    dplyr::left_join(fred_quarterly, by = "QUARTER") %>%
    dplyr::arrange(QUARTER) %>%
    dplyr::mutate(
      d_vol_nbfi  = vol_nbfi - dplyr::lag(vol_nbfi),
      d_vol_bank  = vol_bank - dplyr::lag(vol_bank),
      delta_delta = d_vol_nbfi - d_vol_bank,
      d_vix       = vix - dplyr::lag(vix)
    ) %>%
    dplyr::filter(!is.na(delta_delta), !is.na(d_vix))

  reg_dd <- lm(delta_delta ~ d_vix, data = bn)

  # erreurs-type Newey-West (autocorrélation et hétéroscédasticité)
  cat("Régression Δ(NBFI) - Δ(Bank) sur ΔVIX, SE Newey-West :\n")
  print(lmtest::coeftest(reg_dd, vcov = sandwich::NeweyWest(reg_dd)))
```
